title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
title_zh: 面向一致长视频生成的互补检索增强提示

paragraphs.en: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains challenging because independently generated shots must preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the complete set of elements required for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate improved cross-shot character, object, and scene consistency over memory-based and agentic retrieval baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管近期的视频基础模型在生成高质量短视频方面表现出色，但长视频生成仍然充满挑战，因为独立生成的镜头必须在整篇故事中保持人物、场景和物体的一致性。 现有的免训练方法通常利用检索到的历史视觉内容来约束目标镜头。 然而，这些参考内容往往存在严重的信息不匹配问题：要么引入无关的上下文冗余，要么无法提供目标镜头所需的完整元素集合。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了互补检索增强提示（Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting），这是一个智能体式框架，能够策略性地聚合一组紧凑且相互补充的历史参考，从而在无需重新训练或修改底层生成器的情况下，为长视频生成实现完整且具针对性的条件约束。 具体而言，我们的框架通过将叙事剧本解析为以文本为锚点的视觉元素注册表，显式建模每个目标镜头所需的视觉元素，该注册表跟踪人物、物体、场景及其镜头级状态。 由视觉语言模型（VLM）标注的关键帧库进一步将这些元素映射到过去的视觉观察结果。 在所需元素的引导下，我们的智能体检索能够最大化目标元素覆盖率、同时最小化历史噪声的互补参考。 最后，检索到的参考内容、结构化的元素状态以及锚定指令被整合为统一提示，输入给冻结的视频生成器。 这一元素感知的处理过程在提供全面条件约束的同时保持完全可解释。 在多镜头故事生成上的定量与定性评估表明，与基于记忆的和智能体检索的基线方法相比，我们的方法提升了跨镜头的人物、物体和场景一致性。

paragraphs.en: Recent video foundation models can synthesize visually rich short clips from text, images, videos, and other multimodal prompts ( Gao et al. 2025 ; Kling Team 2025 ; Huang et al. 2025 ; Bao et al. 2024 ; Alibaba Cloud 2025 ; Google DeepMind 2025 ) . Rather than training a specialized long-video model, creators can decompose a story into shots, generate each shot with an off-the-shelf reference-conditioned model, and assemble the resulting clips into a complete narrative. This shot-by-shot workflow is already widely used in the production of short dramas and motion comics because it is flexible, interpretable, and compatible with rapidly evolving commercial video APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频基础模型能够根据文本、图像、视频以及其他多模态提示合成视觉上丰富的短视频片段（Gao et al. 2025；Kling Team 2025；Huang et al. 2025；Bao et al. 2024；Alibaba Cloud 2025；Google DeepMind 2025）。 创作者无需训练专门的长视频模型，而是可以将一个故事分解为多个镜头，使用现成的参考条件驱动模型生成每个镜头，并将生成的片段组装成完整的叙事。 这种逐镜头的工作流程已经广泛应用于短剧和动态漫画的制作中，因为它灵活、可解释，并且与快速演进的商业视频 API 兼容。

paragraphs.en: However, long-form generation is not simply a matter of stitching short clips together. When each shot is generated independently, recurring characters may drift in appearance, objects may disappear or change shape, and scenes may be reintroduced with inconsistent layouts ( Zhang et al. 2025 ; He et al. 2026 ) . Reference images and videos can mitigate these issues, but they also introduce a new bottleneck: before generating each shot, the system must decide which historical references are useful, which visual elements in those references should be preserved, and which stale elements should be suppressed. In practice, this reference selection and prompt construction process is still largely manual, especially when multiple characters, objects, and locations recur over long temporal gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，长篇生成并不是简单地把短片段拼接在一起。 当每个镜头独立生成时，反复出现的角色可能在外观上发生漂移，物体可能消失或改变形状，场景在重新出现时布局可能不一致（Zhang et al. 2025；He et al. 2026）。 参考图像和视频可以缓解这些问题，但它们也带来了新的瓶颈：在生成每个镜头之前，系统必须决定哪些历史参考是有用的、这些参考中哪些视觉元素应当保留，以及哪些过时的元素应当被抑制。 在实践中，这种参考选择与提示构建过程在很大程度上仍然是手动的，尤其是当多个角色、物体和场景在长时间间隔后反复出现时。

paragraphs.en: Existing long-form video methods address consistency from different directions, but they leave this reference-management problem underexplored for frozen multimodal video generators. Training-based approaches propagate memory through attention, caches, latent retrieval, or learned conditioning ( Meng et al. 2026 ; Wu et al. 2025b ; An et al. 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Wei et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) , which often incur high computational overhead and lack scalability. Agentic and explicit-memory pipelines improve controllability by maintaining scripts, entities, or generated keyframes ( Lin et al. 2024 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2025a ; Huang et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2026 ; Zhou et al. 2026 ; Yin et al. 2026 ; Lai et al. 2026 ) , but they often rely on predefined full-script analysis, entity-level canonical references, or manually designed prompt/reference layouts. These designs are powerful, yet less suited to incremental and interactive creation where users may extend or revise the story while generation proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的长视频方法从不同方向解决一致性问题，但对于冻结的多模态视频生成器，它们对这一参考管理问题的研究仍然不足。 基于训练的方法通过注意力、缓存、潜变量检索或学习到的条件机制传递记忆（Meng et al. 2026；Wu et al. 2025b；An et al. 2026；Luo et al. 2026；Zhang et al. 2025；Wei et al. 2026；Hu et al. 2026），这通常带来高昂的计算开销且缺乏可扩展性。 智能体式与显式记忆的流水线通过维护脚本、实体或生成的关键帧来提升可控性（Lin et al. 2024；Zheng et al. 2024；Wu et al. 2025a；Huang et al. 2026；Liu et al. 2026；Zhou et al. 2026；Yin et al. 2026；Lai et al. 2026），但它们往往依赖预先定义的完整脚本分析、实体级的规范参考，或手工设计的提示/参考布局。 这些设计功能强大，但不太适合增量式和交互式创作，因为用户可能在生成进行的同时扩展或修改故事。

paragraphs.en: We propose Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting , an agentic framework that treats long-form video generation as an interpretable retrieval and multimodal prompting problem. The agent maintains two evolving evidence structures. First, a text-grounded visual element registry tracks characters, objects, and scenes introduced by the script, together with shot-level states such as should-reference, should-exclude, optional, and newly introduced. Second, a VLM-annotated keyframe library records where these elements appear in generated shots, using both element-level annotations and holistic frame descriptions. Given a new shot, the agent retrieves a compact set of complementary historical keyframes that jointly cover the required visual elements while penalizing references that may introduce conflicting content. These selected references are then converted into a structured multimodal prompt that explicitly explains how each image should be used or avoided by the frozen generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出互补检索增强提示（Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting），这是一个将长视频生成视为可解释检索与多模态提示问题的智能体框架。 该智能体维护两个不断演化的证据结构。 首先，一个以文本为依据的视觉元素注册表跟踪脚本中引入的角色、物体和场景，并记录镜头级别的状态，例如应引用、应排除、可选和新增。 其次，一个由视觉语言模型标注的关键帧库记录这些元素在生成镜头中出现的位置，同时使用元素级标注和整体帧描述。 面对新镜头时，智能体检索一组紧凑的互补历史关键帧，使其共同覆盖所需的视觉元素，同时惩罚可能引入冲突内容的参考。 随后，这些被选中的参考被转换为结构化的多模态提示，明确说明冻结的生成器应如何使用或避免每张图像。

paragraphs.en: This formulation has two practical advantages. First, it makes reference usage explainable: each selected frame can be traced to the visual elements it covers and the risks it may introduce. Second, it supports online and interactive generation: the registry and keyframe library are updated after each generated shot, so the system does not require a complete script or a fixed generation schedule in advance. Long-range visual consistency is handled by retrieval over historical evidence, while local temporal continuity between non-cut shots can be handled separately through proximal video references and lightweight boundary smoothing.
paragraphs.zh: 这种表述方式有两个实用优势。 首先，它使参考用法可解释：每个被选中的关键帧都可以追溯到它所覆盖的视觉元素以及它可能引入的风险。 其次，它支持在线交互式生成：注册表和关键帧库会在每个生成的镜头之后更新，因此系统不需要预先提供完整脚本或固定的生成计划。 长程视觉一致性通过对历史证据的检索来处理，而非剪辑镜头之间的局部时序连续性则可以通过邻近视频参考和轻量级边界平滑来单独处理。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a training-free, online framework that maintains a visual element registry and a VLM-annotated keyframe library, turning generated history into structured and editable evidence without requiring the full script in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练的在线框架，该框架维护一个视觉元素注册表和一个由视觉语言模型标注的关键帧库，将生成历史转化为结构化且可编辑的证据，而无需提前获取完整脚本。

paragraphs.en: We formulate reference selection as a complementary coverage problem and develop a greedy retrieval algorithm that selects compact historical references covering target elements while suppressing conflicting content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将参考选择问题形式化为一个互补覆盖问题，并开发了一种贪婪检索算法，该算法在抑制冲突内容的同时，选取能够覆盖目标元素的紧凑历史参考。

paragraphs.en: We ground each retrieved frame through element-level and holistic guidance in a structured multimodal prompt. Experiments on EntityBench demonstrate improved cross-shot consistency over training-based methods and explicit workflow baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过结构化多模态提示中的元素级和整体性引导，对每个检索到的帧进行接地。 在 EntityBench 上的实验表明，相较于基于训练的方法和显式工作流基线，本方法提升了跨镜头一致性。

paragraphs.en: Training-based methods embed cross-shot consistency into the generator itself. HoloCine ( Meng et al. 2026 ) and CineTrans ( Wu et al. 2025b ) jointly generate multiple shots and leverage cross-shot attention to preserve visual consistency, while autoregressive and memory-based approaches propagate selected frames, feature caches, attention sinks, reconstructed subjects, or retrieved latents across generation steps ( An et al. 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Wei et al. 2026 ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) . Although effective, these mechanisms require model-specific training or access to internal representations, limiting both their portability across video generators and the interpretability of their historical conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于训练的方法将跨镜头一致性嵌入到生成器本身中。 HoloCine（Meng et al. 2026）和 CineTrans（Wu et al. 2025b）联合生成多个镜头，并利用跨镜头注意力来保持视觉一致性，而自回归和基于记忆的方法则在生成步骤之间传播选定的帧、特征缓存、注意力锚点、重建的主体或检索到的潜变量（An et al. 2026；Luo et al. 2026；Zhang et al. 2025；Wei et al. 2026；Chen et al. 2026；Hu et al. 2026）。 尽管有效，这些机制需要针对特定模型的训练或访问内部表示，这既限制了它们在不同视频生成器之间的可移植性，也限制了其历史条件化的可解释性。

paragraphs.en: Agentic pipelines organize existing generators through script decomposition, shot planning, context allocation, and iterative visual feedback ( Lin et al. 2024 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2025a ; Huang et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2026 ) . Entity-centric systems further maintain explicit states for recurring characters, objects, and scenes ( Zhou et al. 2026 ; Yin et al. 2026 ) . Meanwhile, reference-conditioned generators such as Seedance, Kling-Omni, Step-Video, and Vidu support multimodal prompting over text, images, and videos ( Gao et al. 2025 ; Kling Team 2025 ; Huang et al. 2025 ; Bao et al. 2024 ) , but long-form workflows still rely heavily on manual reference selection and prompting. GroundShot ( Lai et al. 2026 ) reduces this burden by analyzing the full script, scheduling entity-reference shots first, and grounding subsequent shots on the resulting entity memory, but still relies on a predefined complete generation task.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化流水线通过脚本分解、镜头规划、上下文分配和迭代式视觉反馈来组织现有的生成器（Lin et al. 2024；Zheng et al. 2024；Wu et al. 2025a；Huang et al. 2026；Liu et al. 2026）。 以实体为中心的系统进一步为反复出现的角色、物体和场景维护显式状态（Zhou et al. 2026；Yin et al. 2026）。 与此同时，Seedance、Kling-Omni、Step-Video 和 Vidu 等基于参考条件的生成器支持跨文本、图像和视频的多模态提示（Gao et al. 2025；Kling Team 2025；Huang et al. 2025；Bao et al. 2024），但长片工作流仍在很大程度上依赖人工选择参考和编写提示。 GroundShot（Lai et al. 2026）通过分析完整剧本、优先调度实体参考镜头，并将后续镜头锚定于由此产生的实体记忆，减轻了这一负担，但仍然依赖于预先定义的完整生成任务。

paragraphs.en: Our framework instead supports incremental creation without a complete script or predefined generation order. It treats generated keyframes as VLM-annotated evidence, retrieves complementary frames under a limited reference budget, and explicitly grounds how each frame should be used while suppressing obsolete or conflicting content. This yields an interpretable and model-agnostic interface for frozen multimodal video generators.

paragraphs.en: We study long-form story video generation by leveraging the exceptional visual quality and robust physical modeling capabilities of frozen short-video generators. Given a narrative script decomposed into a sequence of T T shots 𝒮 = { s 1 , … , s T } \mathcal{S}=\{s_{1},\ldots,s_{T}\} , each shot s t s_{t} is generated through an independent inference call, and the generator retains no internal memory across shots. The central challenge is how to strategically construct a targeted multimodal prompt with historical references to preserve the consistency of characters, objects, and scenes across shots. To address this challenge, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting , an agentic framework designed to strategically orchestrate inference-stage historical conditioning. Instead of relying on passive, recency-biased retrieval, our method formalizes reference selection as an optimization problem where historical frames are selected if and only if they collectively maximize the coverage of the target shot’s required elements while minimizing informational redundancy. Under this formulation, an agent continuously tracks structured visual evidence and retrieves a compact set of complementary historical references to drive the generation loop. The library establishes explicit cross-modal mappings to the active registry ℛ \mathcal{R} . Rather than compressing historical video dynamics into holistic visual embeddings, the agent dynamically appends informative instances to ℒ \mathcal{L} , forming a high-diversity candidate reference pool for downstream complementary matching.
paragraphs.zh: 为了建立一个结构化且可查询的视觉记忆，我们的框架构建了一个元素链接关键帧库 ℒ = { f k } k = 1 M t \mathcal{L}=\{f_{k}\}_{k=1}^{M_{t}} ，其中 M t M_{t} 表示在生成镜头 s t s_{t} 之前可用的历史关键帧数量。 该库与活动注册表 ℛ \mathcal{R} 之间建立了显式的跨模态映射。 智能体并非将历史视频动态压缩为整体式视觉嵌入，而是动态地向 ℒ \mathcal{L} 追加信息丰富的实例，从而为下游的互补匹配形成一个高多样性的候选参考池。

paragraphs.en: Fidelity Filtering: Candidate frames from the newly synthesized clip are first evaluated via HPSv3 ( Ma et al. 2025 ) . Visually degraded, blurred, or artifact-heavy frames are discarded to ensure reference quality.

sents.zh: 保真度过滤：首先通过 HPSv3（Ma et al. 2025）对新合成片段中的候选帧进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Temporal Drift Detection: For the remaining candidate pool, we compute semantic cosine distance using CLIP image features ( Radford et al. 2021 ) . paragraphs.zh: 时间漂移检测：针对剩余的候选池，我们使用 CLIP 图像特征（Radford et al. 2021）计算语义余弦距离。 当且仅当某帧与同一镜头内紧邻的前一个已接受关键帧的相似度低于特定阈值，表明视觉状态发生了明显转变时，该合格帧才会作为新的关键帧 f_{k} 提交至 ℒ。

paragraphs.en: By comparing frames only with local within-shot history rather than performing aggressive global cross-shot deduplication, this protocol preserves diverse visual perspectives and gives the downstream retriever richer choices.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议仅将帧与镜头内的局部历史进行比较，而不执行激进的全局跨镜头去重，从而保留了多样化的视觉视角，并为下游检索器提供了更丰富的选择。

paragraphs.en: Once a keyframe f k f_{k} is committed to ℒ \mathcal{L} , a VLM processes it to produce a dual-level semantic representation for downstream use:
paragraphs.zh: 一旦关键帧 f_{k} 被提交至 ℒ \mathcal{L}，VLM 便会对其进行处理，生成一个双层级语义表示以供下游使用：

paragraphs.en: Element-Level Annotations ( 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} ): The VLM executes closed-set entity verification against ℛ \mathcal{R} . A full element is complete and clearly identifiable; for a character, it additionally requires a clear frontal face. A partial element is identifiable but occluded, truncated, or, for a character, lacks a clear frontal face, whereas a weak element provides insufficient detail for reliable identity reference. For global environmental backdrops ( type i = scene \text{type}_{i}=\text{scene} ), the spatial region b k , i b_{k,i} defaults to the full image canvas.
paragraphs.zh: 元素级标注（ 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} ）：VLM 针对集合 ℛ \mathcal{R} 执行封闭集实体验证。 对于每个被追踪的元素 e i ∈ ℛ e_{i}\in\mathcal{R} ， 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} 记录其存在指示符 a k , i ∈ { 0 , 1 } a_{k,i}\in\{0,1\} 、定位边界框 b k , i b_{k,i} ，以及类别化的参考保真度标签 q k , i ∈ { full , partial , weak } q_{k,i}\in\{\texttt{full},\texttt{partial},\texttt{weak}\} 。 full 元素是完整且清晰可辨识的；对于角色而言，还需要有清晰的正面面部。 partial 元素可被辨识但被遮挡、截断，或对于角色而言缺少清晰的正面面部，而 weak 元素提供的细节不足以作为可靠的身份参考。 对于全局环境背景（ type i = scene \text{type}_{i}=\text{scene} ），空间区域 b k , i b_{k,i} 默认为整幅图像画布。

paragraphs.en: Holistic Frame Description ( 𝐃 k \mathbf{D}_{k} ): Conditioned on the narrative context, the VLM produces a comprehensive textual summary detailing the global composition, artistic style, core action, and plot-level relevance of the entire frame.
paragraphs.zh: 整体帧描述（ 𝐃 k \mathbf{D}_{k} ）：以叙事上下文为条件，VLM 生成一份全面的文本摘要，详细描述整个画面的全局构图、艺术风格、核心动作以及情节层面的相关性。

paragraphs.en: This two-tiered design decouples symbolic subset optimization from prompt context alignment. Structurally, the element-level matrix 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} translates each frame into verifiable evidence for greedy retrieval, explicitly revealing which elements a frame covers and which excluded assets it might introduce. Semantically, the holistic descriptions 𝐃 k \mathbf{D}_{k} provide natural-language context, enabling the prompt agent to articulate how the reference frame should be interpreted by the frozen generator.
paragraphs.zh: 这种双层设计将符号化子集优化与提示词上下文对齐解耦。 在结构上，元素级矩阵 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} 将每一帧转化为用于贪心检索的可验证证据，明确揭示该帧覆盖了哪些元素，以及可能引入哪些被排除的资产。 在语义上，整体描述 𝐃 k \mathbf{D}_{k} 提供自然语言上下文，使提示词智能体能够阐明冻结生成器应如何解读参考帧。

paragraphs.en: Standard similarity-based Top- K K retrieval ( Hu et al. 2026 ; An et al. 2026 ; Wei et al. 2026 ) frequently selects redundant historical frames depicting identical salient elements, leaving other critical story elements uncovered while compounding historical noise. To circumvent this, we formalize reference selection as a complementary coverage problem , seeking a compact subset of keyframes that collectively maximizes target-element coverage while systematically suppressing contextual leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 基于相似度的标准 Top-K 检索（Hu et al. 2026；An et al. 2026；Wei et al. 2026）经常选择描绘相同显著元素的冗余历史帧，导致其他关键故事元素未被覆盖，同时加剧了历史噪声。 为避免这一问题，我们将参考帧选择形式化为一个互补覆盖问题，寻求一个由关键帧组成的紧凑子集，使其共同最大化目标元素覆盖，同时系统地抑制上下文泄漏。

paragraphs.en: Our framework greedily constructs a compact reference set S S ( | S | ≤ K |S|\leq K ). At each round, Algorithm 1 rescores every unselected candidate according to the dynamically updated set C C of already covered required elements. The weights satisfy w uncovered ​ REF > w covered ​ REF ≥ 0 w_{\mathrm{uncovered\ REF}}>w_{\mathrm{covered\ REF}}\geq 0 , w OPT ≥ 0 w_{\mathrm{OPT}}\geq 0 , and w EXC < 0 w_{\mathrm{EXC}}<0 . Each visible element contributes according to its state: uncovered required elements receive positive rewards, covered or optional elements receive a small or zero reward, and excluded elements incur a negative contribution.

paragraphs.en: We adopt the Cross-Shot Consistency evaluation from EntityBench ( He et al. 2026 ) , which measures whether recurring characters, objects, and scenes remain consistent across shots. It combines two complementary protocols. First, DINOv2 embedding similarity compares character and object appearances with their per-entity centroids, while a transition-boundary metric measures continuity across scene-internal cuts. Second, LLM pairwise judging compares each non-anchor appearance with a centroid-representative anchor using type-specific criteria, reporting both accuracy and fine-grained similarity; locations are evaluated from full frames with camera-invariant instructions to accommodate viewpoint changes and partial views. The 21 metrics are grouped into DINOv2 Similarity (3), LLM Characters (6), LLM Objects (6), and LLM Scenes (6), with Overall denoting their mean. EntityBench additionally reports intra-shot metrics including quality and prompt following, which we omit as they primarily evaluate the base video generator rather than cross-shot reference construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用来自 EntityBench（He et al. 2026）的跨镜头一致性评估，该评估衡量反复出现的角色、物体和场景在各个镜头之间是否保持一致。 它结合了两种互补的协议。 首先，DINOv2 嵌入相似度将角色和物体的外观与其逐实体的质心进行比较，同时一个转场边界指标衡量场景内部剪切之间的连续性。 其次，LLM 成对评判使用特定类型的标准将每个非锚点外观与质心代表性锚点进行比较，同时报告准确率和细粒度相似度；位置则基于完整帧并结合相机不变的指令进行评估，以适应视角变化和部分可见的情况。 这 21 项指标被分为 DINOv2 相似度（3）、LLM 角色（6）、LLM 物体（6）和 LLM 场景（6），Overall 表示它们的均值。 EntityBench 还报告了包括质量和提示遵循在内的镜头内指标，我们将其省略，因为它们主要评估基础视频生成器而非跨镜头参考构建。

paragraphs.en: Dataset construction and generation. EntityBench contains 140 long-range multi-shot episodes. We use an LLM to filter scripts with obvious copyright or sensitive-content risks, yielding 105 eligible episodes, and randomly sample 20 Easy, 10 Mid, and 5 Hard episodes as our test set. Every shot is generated at 480P for 5 seconds. To comply with the moderation constraints of Seedance 2.0, all methods prepend the same instruction requiring non-photorealistic 2D animated human faces and original, non-copyrighted character designs. No predefined character sheets or external reference images are supplied; all visual evidence is generated from the script during inference.

paragraphs.en: Keyframe library and evaluation. StoryMem stores flat keyframe files, retains at most three diverse keyframes per shot under HPSv3 ≥ 3.0 \geq 3.0 and CLIP similarity < 0.9 <0.9 , deduplicates against the complete history, and restricts inference to its Sink–Recent window. In contrast, our library retains up to six diverse keyframes per shot under HPSv3 ≥ 2.5 \geq 2.5 and CLIP similarity < 0.95 <0.95 , only filters near-duplicate adjacent additions, preserves all historical candidates, and attaches VLM element-presence boxes, reference-quality labels, and holistic descriptions. We evaluate all methods using the official EntityBench implementation, replacing its default Gemini judge with Doubao Seed2.1 Turbo uniformly for every method.

paragraphs.en: We compare against seven representative baselines from recent advances in multi-shot video generation, organized into two groups. The first comprises training-based methods with dedicated generation models: CineTrans ( Wu et al. 2025b ) , HoloCine ( Meng et al. 2026 ) , LongLive2.0 ( Chen et al. 2026 ) , and ShotStream ( Luo et al. 2026 ) . The second evaluates explicit reference-construction workflows using the same commercial video API. VideoMemory ( Zhou et al. 2026 ) and ViMax ( Huang et al. 2026 ) first synthesize dedicated reference images and then condition video generation on them, whereas StoryMem ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) and our approach use keyframes mined from generated history. Although the official StoryMem implementation adapts Wan2.2 with LoRA for multi-reference video generation, its memory construction and keyframe-selection procedures are explicit and deterministic. For a fair comparison, our StoryMem reproduction preserves these procedures while replacing the video generator with the same Seedance2.0 backend.

paragraphs.en: The results also reveal a metric-dependent pattern. Training-based methods such as LongLive2.0 and ShotStream are particularly competitive in DINOv2 similarity. Their model-internal propagation of history through cross-shot attention, caches, or related memory mechanisms may better preserve embedding-level appearance, and their training objectives may reinforce this effect. However, their lower LLM scores indicate that high feature similarity does not necessarily imply preservation of the correct character attributes, object states, or scene semantics. In contrast, the explicit workflows generally perform better under these fine-grained multimodal judgments, suggesting an advantage from explicitly organizing and grounding historical evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 结果还揭示了一种依赖指标的模式。 基于训练的方法（如 LongLive2.0 和 ShotStream）在 DINOv2 相似度方面尤其具有竞争力。 它们通过跨镜头注意力、缓存或相关记忆机制在模型内部传播历史信息，这可能更好地保留嵌入层面的外观，而其训练目标也可能强化了这一效果。 然而，它们较低的 LLM 分数表明，高特征相似度并不一定意味着正确保留了角色属性、对象状态或场景语义。 相比之下，显式工作流在这些细粒度的多模态判断下通常表现更好，这表明显式组织和落地历史证据带来了优势。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 demonstrates that Full yields the highest Overall score and ranks first across all four evaluation criteria. w/o Cover lowers Overall by 0.0188 and degrades every reported metric, confirming that independently high-scoring frames do not necessarily form a complementary reference set. w/o Prompting lowers Overall by 0.0179 and character consistency by 0.0417, indicating that selected images remain ambiguous unless the generator is told which evidence to preserve and which historical content to suppress. CLIP Retrieval trails Full by 0.0214 in Overall and 0.0523 in character consistency. paragraphs.en: We presented Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, a training-free framework for consistent long-form video generation with frozen short-video generators. Instead of compressing visual history into implicit memory or relying on manually curated references, our framework maintains a text-grounded visual element registry together with a VLM-annotated keyframe library, turning generated history into structured and queryable evidence. Coverage-aware retrieval selects a compact set of complementary frames, while grounded multimodal prompting specifies what each frame should contribute and which stale content should be suppressed. EntityBench experiments demonstrate superior cross-shot consistency, while ablations validate complementary retrieval and reference grounding. Beyond accuracy, the explicit intermediate representations make reference decisions interpretable and editable, supporting interactive creation without a complete script. Separating evidence maintenance, retrieval, and generation also facilitates backend portability and allows failures to be traced to individual pipeline stages rather than hidden within model states. Current limitations include errors in element planning and visual annotation, imperfect prompt adherence by the underlying generator, and constraints imposed by commercial APIs. Future work will improve agentic verification, scale retrieval to longer narratives, and strengthen transfer across video-generation backends and interactive production settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了互补检索增强提示（Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting），这是一个无需训练的框架，可基于冻结的短视频生成器实现一致性的长视频生成。 我们的框架没有将视觉历史压缩进隐式记忆，也不依赖人工筛选的参考内容，而是维护一个以文本为依据的视觉元素注册表以及一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）标注的关键帧库，将已生成的内容转化为结构化且可查询的证据。 覆盖度感知的检索会选出一小组互补的帧，而基于依据的多模态提示则指明每帧应当贡献什么内容，以及哪些过时的内容应被抑制。 EntityBench 实验证明了卓越的跨镜头一致性，消融实验则验证了互补检索与依据引导参考的有效性。 除准确性之外，显式的中间表示使参考决策具备可解释性和可编辑性，从而在缺乏完整剧本的情况下支持交互式创作。 将证据维护、检索与生成相互分离，也便于后端的可移植性，并使失败能够被追溯到流水线中的具体阶段，而非隐藏在模型状态之中。 当前的局限包括元素规划与视觉标注中的错误、底层生成器对提示遵循不够完善，以及商业 API 带来的限制。 未来的工作将改进智能体验证、将检索扩展至更长的叙事，并加强在不同视频生成后端与交互式制作场景之间的迁移能力。
